conventions.decomposition: triples i<=j<=k, P1+P2+P3=R; logs known by construction; membership via log->index map
conventions.qr_base: first B distinct points of a deterministic r-adding walk (r=20, c_j in [1,2^10)) off G with x a QR mod p
conventions.small_mult_base: x(jG), j=1..2B deduplicated by x, truncated to B
conventions.targets: 800 uniform targets per curve, same set for all bases
